svg.title: Layer norm against RMSNorm on the token [1, 3, 1, 3]: layer norm slides the mean down to 0, RMSNorm only shrinks every value until the RMS is 1

g.text: the same token [1, 3, 1, 3], steadied two ways
subtract it, every bar slides down by 2
divide by it, every bar shrinks, none moves
on [2, −2, 2, −2] the mean is already 0, and both give [1, −1, 1, −1]
layer norm uses two statistics, RMSNorm uses one
RMSNorm skips the mean and only rescales
